meta.analysis: D05 fixed descriptive weather/context matching and geography contrasts
meta.context_reference: equal full-D county-event rows, outcome-blind mean/SD, no imputation
meta.neighbor_rule: three eligible distinct other counties, combined RMS ascending, deterministic unit-index tie break
meta.absolute_time: panel.meta.origin[unit] + (time-72) hours UTC; same-system origins asserted identical
meta.geography_missing_rule: coordinate is valid only when focal and all three controls have finite standardized geography; other coordinates retained
meta.interpretation: all 40 marginal through-origin weighted slopes; correlated geography, descriptive association, no independent or causal effects

full_risk_clock.focal_weight_rule: unit w / observation-valid fixed clock count
